Introduction to AI in Marketing

Thank you everyone for joining. I'm very excited for this webinar. We have been focusing on AI implementation within marketing. Today, we're speaking about inbound leads management. This is a hot topic for many marketers, whether in B2B or B2C. Managing leads effectively is crucial, and that's what we'll discuss with Jeff today.

Achieving Amazing Results with AI

Jeff has achieved impressive results using AI with several clients. For one client, they saved twenty hours per month while processing ten thousand leads. This level of efficiency is what we're aiming to help you achieve.

Webinar Agenda

We'll start with a quick introduction, followed by two practical demos. We'll show you how Jeff parses leads through different sources using AI and how to distribute those leads to your sales team using a round robin method.

Introduction to Make

Make is a powerful automation tool for automating workflows, no matter how simple or complex. Jeff will demonstrate the product during this webinar. Now, let's hear from Jeff about FourSpot Consulting.

FourSpot Consulting

FourSpot Consulting has been in business for eleven years, focusing on automation. We've been using Make almost exclusively for our automations. We are adept at using OpenAI, Dropbox, and various CRMs like Keep, GoHighLevel, and Google Suite. Our superpower is finding solutions with data. If we have data available, we can make it work.

First Client Challenge: Parsing Leads

Our first client was a larger organization with multiple lead sources, most without API capabilities. They needed to eliminate manual data entry and reduce the time and cost for manual edits. We used email parsing and an AI step to automate this process, saving them over two hours per lead.

Lead Sources

Lead sources can vary. While many think of advertising platforms like LinkedIn or Google Ads, there are also lead generation companies that send leads via email. These leads need to be processed quickly to be the first on the phone with potential clients. Our solution streamlined this process.

Implementing the Solution

We built a scenario in Make that uses a mail hook to trigger automation every time a new lead is received. The email content is parsed using AI, formatted, and then fed into the CRM. This eliminated manual edits and reduced processing time significantly.

Setting Up the Scenario

We set up a mail hook with a specific email address to trigger the automation. The email content is fed into ChatGPT with specific instructions to extract lead information. The extracted data is then formatted using JSON parsing and mapped into the CRM.

Round Robin Lead Distribution

After capturing leads, the next step is to distribute them to the sales team. A round robin method ensures even distribution. Our client needed to eliminate manual intervention and handle multiple criteria for lead distribution. We automated this process, saving them over twenty hours per month.

Understanding Round Robin

Round robin means distributing leads in sequence. The first lead goes to salesperson one, the second to salesperson two, and so on. After reaching the last salesperson, the sequence starts again from the first.

Setting Up Round Robin

We used a data store in Make to dynamically handle the salespeople. The scenario counts the total number of users and determines the next person in line to receive a lead. The lead is then assigned to the salesperson, and the next person is marked as available for the next lead.

Advanced Round Robin Implementation

For our client, we built a more complex scenario to handle additional criteria, such as checking for existing clients and geolocation. This ensured leads were assigned to the appropriate salesperson based on location and other factors.

Dynamic and Scalable Automation

This round robin solution is dynamic and can easily scale with changes in the sales team. Adding or removing salespeople is straightforward, and the automation continues to run smoothly, adapting to the changes.

Sharing the Blueprints

We will share the blueprints for these scenarios, allowing you to copy and customize them for your own needs. This will enable you to start automating your lead management processes efficiently.

Conclusion

The power of AI and automation can transform your lead management processes, saving time and reducing manual effort. By implementing solutions like email parsing and round robin lead distribution, you can achieve significant efficiency gains.

Join Our Community

We encourage you to join our community and continue learning about automation. Sign up for a free Make account and start automating your work today. If you need assistance, FourSpot Consulting offers consultations to help you get started.

Q&A Session

We addressed various questions during the webinar, including the choice of GPT model and the use of JSON parsing. For specific legal concerns, consult your legal team to ensure compliance with regulations.

Final Thoughts

We have several webinars lined up on AI, automation, marketing, and more. Stay tuned for more exciting content. Thank you for attending, and have a great day!
